name: hammer
description: Hammer worlds: corpora that publish what they cannot answer, reached over MCP, with the discipline for reading one without overstating it.

plugins.name: hammer-worlds
plugins.description: Mounts the hosted coverage-intelligence world over HTTP and carries the one skill that is about the discipline rather than any corpus: how to route a question through the worlds a client has mounted, why two worlds' answers never compose into a third claim, how to read a refusal, and the claim report every answer built on a world has to close with. Each world ships its own routing instructions from its own deployed build, so nothing here can describe a version that no longer exists.
